parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is the main upper part made of durable plastic, typically shaped to fit comfortably in the hand.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal mechanism that pushes staples through paper when pressed down.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates downward around a hinge to press the staple into the paper.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a metallic component that covers the staple magazine and connects to the body via a hinge.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the staple magazine in place and provides structural support for the stapling mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves upward when reloading staples and downward during stapling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the lower part of the stapler, made of plastic with a metal plate for staple bending.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable surface for paper placement and bends the staple legs inward to secure sheets.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the upper body moves during stapling.
